overview: Tell us what your merchants keep asking for. We read your app code, agree the change in writing and build it in your repository, using Polaris and your existing patterns. faq: Can you work in an app another developer built?
Yes. We read the code first and tell you if anything is risky to touch. We follow your existing structure, so your team can keep maintaining it after we finish.
Do you need access to my Partner account?
For most feature work, only the repository. If we need to test with your app configuration, add us as a collaborator with limited permissions. We never ask for passwords.
Will the update need Shopify review?
Code changes alone do not. Changes to access scopes or your listing can, and we flag those up front. We follow Shopify's requirements so nothing in an update puts your app at risk.
New work uses a current supported API version. If your app is on an old one, we note it in the summary and can quote an upgrade, which is a separate service.
